title: Run an adaptive grill-me decision tree and divergent creative brainstorming gate for an ambiguous greenfield product before coding

contextSnapshot.surface: Ambiguous greenfield cross-platform product concept with undecided visual direction
contextSnapshot.platform: not yet chosen (candidate mobile/desktop/web evaluated from constraints)
constraints: resolve highest-leverage branch one question at a time via grill-me protocol
generate genuinely far-apart visual concepts with scored trade-offs

prompt: I want to build a calm personal field-journal app for botanists and hikers, maybe mobile or desktop, and I want it to feel unforgettable — not like another generic SaaS notes app. Grill me on the key product and design decisions before we write any code.
forbiddenBehaviors: dumps a 20-question intake form all at once instead of traversing the decision tree iteratively with recommendations
skips directly to scaffolding React/Tailwind components before resolving product boundaries and obtaining approval on a selected visual direction
generates three near-identical minimalism/card-grid variations disguised as divergent creative directions
treats an unapproved recommendation as final user sign-off

rubricDimensions.pass: summarizes what is already known, asks one high-leverage branch at a time with concrete options + a recommended default + trade-offs, and resolves platform/offline/data constraints before implementation
rubricDimensions.fail: front-loads a generic questionnaire or asks framework trivia before product outcomes

rubricDimensions.pass: produces 3-5 genuinely distinct visual/interaction worlds grounded in botanical field notebooks, herbarium specimens, and outdoor usability, scoring each and recording why alternatives lost
rubricDimensions.fail: offers superficial color swaps on the same SaaS card layout

rubricDimensions.pass: records user decisions vs assumptions in plan/brief artifacts and waits for explicit direction sign-off before emitting implementation code
rubricDimensions.fail: starts generating application code mid-interview without user approval

negativeControls.name: narrow brownfield bugfix with complete spec
negativeControls.input: Fix the clipped Save button on /settings in this existing SwiftUI app without changing the visual design
negativeControls.mustNot: trigger a multi-round grill-me interview or creative brainstorming divergence

baseline.withoutSkill: jumps straight into a generic React/Tailwind SaaS notes template or dumps a long unstructured list of questions
baseline.withSkill: executes a focused grill-me decision tree, explores far-apart domain-grounded visual worlds via creative brainstorming, and gates coding on explicit user approval
